verdicts.reason: A has empty dead space at the top because the logo is pushed down to about y=128. The big teal circle has been moved inward, so it sits behind the GLACIER logo and the product's right edge, which looks unintended. The legal line floats about 100px above the bottom edge on top of the oversized lower circle, and the bottom quarter is mostly empty. B keeps the original's centred vertical stack: logo at the top, product, headline, CTA, then legal at the bottom. Its decorative circles are scaled down and tucked into the corners so they don't collide with anything, and the headline and CTA stay dominant. Its only flaws are minor: the legal text is still tiny and almost touches the lower-left circle, and the corner circles look a little small and isolated.
